recipe.title: South Indian Spicy Chicken Masala Pasta
recipe.description: Tender chicken and pasta coated in a fiery South Indian-style onion, tomato, and chilli spiced sauce enriched with milk and cheese.
recipe.serving: Serve piping hot alongside fresh cucumber slices.

instructions.step: Bring water to a boil, cook pasta for 7 minutes until tender, then drain.
instructions.tip: Chop the chicken small while the pasta cooks.

instructions.step: Heat cooking oil in a skillet, then fry the chopped onions and tomatoes until softened.
instructions.tip: Stir frequently to soften tomatoes into a pulp.

instructions.step: Add the diced chicken, chilli powder, and salt, stirring until the chicken turns opaque.
instructions.tip: Ensure the chilli coats all chicken pieces evenly.

instructions.step: Pour in the milk and simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through.
instructions.tip: Lower the heat slightly to avoid splitting the milk.

instructions.step: Add the drained pasta and cheese, tossing constantly until a smooth sauce coats everything.
instructions.tip: Take off heat promptly once cheese has melted.
